issue_context.title: Provide ALC name in DispatchProxy for proxies in custom ALC
issue_context.body:
With https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/62095 issues with proxies loaded from custom ALC is fixed and the ALC name was passed to the `AssemblyName` used for creating the Proxy type, but [that was causing issues for ALC that include paths in its name](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/80387). We reverted that part as it was causing a regression. 

Though passing ALC name to the proxy assembly could be useful for debugging purposes and @jkotas suggested a good way for fixing it in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/82807#discussion_r1125160686:
